method: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses; least inconsistent, not most supported

hypotheses.title: ICE contract design and monitoring may insulate GEO operations from proportional financial consequences
The oversight episodes are separate incidents handled through ordinary remedies and readiness purchasing

interpretation: Hypothesis 335 is now narrowly least inconsistent because Northwest's contract-minimum recommendation remained unresolved/open and two deficiencies repeated after a completed UCAP. This is not confirmation. Later extensions, renewals, funding, and capacity actions remain neutral because the public action descriptions do not disclose performance treatment. Folkston supports 335; Golden State closure, South Texas readiness management, vendor-paid Folkston overtime, BI credits, and the Torrance comparator preserve substantial evidence for ordinary remedies under 336.
prohibited_inference: The matrix does not establish favoritism, political influence, or causation between an oversight finding and any later award or capacity action.
